headlines.snippet: Mali and Liel Yahalomi withdrew NIS 50,000 and purchased new phones before flying, according to a police source. The two were found on a bus in South America, apparently having flown there from Germany. After a brief interrogation and since there was no suspicion of criminal activity against them, they were released. The family expressed immense relief at their safe discovery and stated that all funds raised by the public would be returned. A police source confirmed they had withdrawn 50,000 shekels in Israel and bought new phones.
